board.lead: Set the place and topic at the top.
board.noPlace: Choose a place to see its pinboard.
board.readOnly: Anyone can read, writing needs an account.
board.none: Nothing found. Choose a larger place or another topic.
board.empty: Nothing on the pinboard yet. Write the first post.
board.pick: Open the replies of a post and it shows here with all its replies.

groups.lead: An initiative is a group with a goal.

people.lead: Search by name or tag, for example “responsible traffic”.
